scenario: An issue asks the agent to record a MachineRefill stock movement (moving stock from storage into a vending machine). The agent's design reduces QuantityInStock (storage) and leaves CostingQuantity, InventoryValue and COGS untouched for that movement.
policyReferences: AGENTS.md § Inventory and historical costing invariants
expectedBehavior: MachineRefill is an internal transfer from storage to a vending machine: it may reduce storage QuantityInStock but must not reduce business CostingQuantity/InventoryValue and must not create COGS.
forbiddenOutcomes: Creating a COGS entry for a MachineRefill movement.
Reducing CostingQuantity or InventoryValue for a MachineRefill movement.

assertions.text: `MachineRefill` is an internal transfer from storage to a vending machine. It can reduce storage quantity, but must not reduce business costing quantity/value and must not create COGS.
